programs.title: Insiders
programs.desc: Amid rising inflation, housing out of reach, cost of living pressures and a global energy crisis, David Speers and the panel cut through the noise with questions and analysis, revealing the power plays behind the politics.

programs.title: Offsiders
programs.desc: Ahead of the FIFA World Cup, Australia take on Switzerland in a final warm-up. Abbey Gelmi and the panel discuss the Socceroos squad and hopes of advancing to the knockout stage. Plus NRL, AFL, Netball and Super Rugby Finals.

programs.title: The World This Week
programs.desc: Girish Sawlani brings you a weekly roundup of international news from an Australian perspective as reported by ABC News correspondents covering the Indo Pacific, Europe, North America, the Middle East, India and Indonesia.

programs.title: Compass
programs.desc: As gang numbers in New Zealand rise, the government is cracking down. Lucky Te Koha, a former gang member turned pastor, moves between chapters, where men are fighting for faith, family, and a chance to redefine themselves.

programs.title: Songs of Praise
programs.desc: Mark De-Lisser hosts a special celebration of inspiring gospel worship from Union Chapel, London, featuring the voices of Michelle John, Wayne Ellington and the Sound Foundation choir.

programs.title: ABC News At Noon
programs.desc: Melissa Mackay presents the latest from ABC News on the weekend bringing you today's top stories and coverage of events as they unfold. Plus original reporting, analysis and updated news, sport, weather and information.

programs.title: Landline
programs.desc: A tasty sampler of stories from the land - covering food, agriculture, crops, climate, business and innovation - as we meet the fascinating people who make our rural and regional communities unique. Presented by Pip Courtney.

programs.title: Gardening Australia
programs.sub_title: Winter: Insects on Show & Cool Climate Cactus
programs.desc: Costa meets a family of avid gardeners, Millie visits an insect expo, Clarence maintains his mower, Sophie visits a garden full of rescued plants, Hannah explores cool climate cactus, and we meet seed saver Paulette Whitney.

programs.title: The Assembly
programs.desc: In this episode, multi Olympic gold medallist Ian Thorpe opens up about pressure, mental health and dating in the public eye. (Season Final).

programs.title: Joanna Lumley's Spice Trail Adventure
programs.desc: In this last episode, Joanna visits Zanzibar where she visits the bustling centre of Stone Town. She visits the East African Slave Trade Exhibit, releases a turtle and helps ladies farm seaweed.

programs.title: Restoration Australia
programs.desc: Host Anthony Burke meets an urban fashion professional who went looking for an idyllic country farmlet and ends up with a cavernous rural convent and a huge restoration task.

programs.title: Back Roads
programs.desc: Back Roads guest presenter Anna Daniels heads to the central Queensland town of Theodore for its 100th birthday. She finds a town honouring its past, but also safeguarding its future, proving anything is possible in the bush.
